text: 民生银行公告，经中国人民银行批准，本行于2026年10月16日完成“中国民生银行股份有限公司2026年金融债券”发行，发行规模为人民币100亿元，期限3年，采用浮动利率，首个计息周期票面利率为1.58%。
text_en: Minsheng Bank announced that, with approval from the People's Bank of China, the bank completed the issuance of "China Minsheng Bank Co., Ltd. 2026 Financial Bonds" on October 16, 2026, with an issuance size of RMB 10 billion, a term of 3 years, using a floating rate, and a coupon rate of 1.58% for the first interest period.
